message.content: ```python import pytest from tornado.escape import linkify def test_basic_linkify(): """Normal URL should be converted to an tag with http:// prefix.""" input_text = "Check out https://example.com/page." expected = 'Check out https://example.com/page.' assert linkify(input_text) == expected def test_shorten_long_url(): """Long URL should be shortened when shorten=True and title added.""" long_url = "https://example.com/very/long/path/to/resource?query=param&another=thing" input_text = f"Visit {long_url} for details." result = linkify(input_text, shorten=True) # The displayed URL should be truncated and end with '...' assert '...' in result # The href should be the full original URL assert f'href="{long_url}"' in result # The title attribute should contain the full URL assert f'title="{long_url}"' in result def test_require_protocol_and_bad_protocol(): """URLs without protocol should not be linkified when require_protocol=True.""" input_text = "Visit www.example.com or http://good.com." result = linkify(input_text, require_protocol=True) # www.example.com should remain plain text assert "www.example.com" in result # http://good.com should be linkified assert 'http://good.com' in result ```
